coffeeChat.mentorConsent:
Mentor notice and consent
· Your reviews on the boards stay anonymous. In a coffee chat, however, the other person may see your face and name.
· Mentoring comes with no reward of any kind, including points. Company referral bonuses follow each company's own program.
· When a request comes in, you send 1 to 3 times that work for you; the requester picks one and sends a Zoom or Google Meet link. Ellieo only helps you connect.
· Career advice is your personal opinion, and Ellieo is not responsible for what is said in the conversation.
· Your LinkedIn goes along with the times you send and is shown to the requester once they confirm a time.
· If you cancel a confirmed coffee chat, the requester's points are refunded.
· A coffee chat request button also appears on the interview and job reviews you wrote.
coffeeChat.requestDisclaimer: Coffee chats are voluntary conversations with mentors. Ellieo does not guarantee any referral, interview, or employment outcome. Any referral is made solely at the mentor's personal discretion and is subject to the policies of the mentor's employer. Ellieo does not receive any monetary benefit from coffee chats or referrals, and mentors are not compensated by Ellieo. When you send a request, your LinkedIn is shared with the mentor. When you send a request, points are put on hold; they are spent when you pick one of the mentor's times and confirm it with a Zoom or Google Meet link. Ellieo does not check whether the call took place. After confirming, points are refunded only if the mentor cancels or you cancel at least 24 hours before the start. If the mentor doesn't show up, please report it in the app.
